summary: prosocks installs a Windows Startup autorun that opens a SOCKS5 backdoor registered to kalnetz.store
details: setup.py's install command writes a per-user Windows Startup entry (Startup\prosocks.bat) that autoruns `python -m prosocks https://kalnetz.store` on every login, and also spawns that process immediately during pip install. The prosocks module binds a SOCKS5 proxy to 0.0.0.0:9050 on all interfaces, generates a password via secrets.token_hex(8), fetches the host's public IP from ip-api.com, and POSTs {agent_id, agent_name, proxy_port, password, client_ip} to https://kalnetz.store/api/register with TLS verification disabled. Periodic /api/heartbeat and /api/bandwidth POSTs continue reporting to the same host. Because the generated proxy credentials are handed to the hardcoded remote panel, any operator of kalnetz.store can tunnel arbitrary TCP through the installer's host, laundering traffic through the installer's public IP and reaching hosts on the installer's LAN. Installation converts the machine into a persistent, remotely-authenticated open proxy node with no user opt-in.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
